note: Ogle County publishes parcels only through the Beacon (Schneider) web viewer, which is not a public ArcGIS REST or file service. Bulk parcel shapefiles are sold ($0.50 each, under 32,000) under a signed license agreement. Official GIS pages list no REST endpoint; ArcGIS Online search found no Ogle parcel layer. Neighbouring Boone and DeKalb use public ArcGIS services, but none was found for Ogle.
